title: Accounting for Software Companies

rows.before: <li>We prepare Form T661 alongside your software company T2 return to claim <a class=\"wpil_keyword_link\" href=\"https:\/\/gondaliyacpa.ca\/claiming-sred-tax-credits-what-canadian-businesses-need-to-know\/\"   title=\"SR&ED tax credits\" data-wpil-keyword-link=\"linked\"  data-wpil-monitor-id=\"7794\">SR&ED tax credits<\/a> on eligible developer salaries, contractor costs, and cloud hosting expenses used for experimental development \u2014 missing the 18-month filing deadline permanently forfeits the refundable credit.<\/li>\r\n

rows.section: Services grid - tax planning card bullet
rows.before: <li>We plan your software company's SR&ED claim timing so the 35% refundable investment tax credit on the first $3 million in qualified developer expenditures is captured in the optimal fiscal year, coordinating with your SaaS company's runway and cash flow needs.<\/li>\r\n

<li>We identify SR&ED-eligible developer expenses in prior unfiled years and prepare retroactive Form T661 claims alongside each catch-up T2 return \u2014 each unfiled year within the 18-month window represents tens of thousands in forfeited refundable credits for your software company.<\/li>\r\n

rows.section: Services grid - CRA audit card bullet
rows.before: <li>Software companies face frequent CRA audits on SR&ED claims \u2014 we defend your Form T661 technical narratives by documenting technological uncertainty, systematic investigation, and eligible developer hours that meet CRA's three-prong SR&ED eligibility test.<\/li>\r\n
Implemented proper accounting and R&D tax credit claims.
